description: A motivated team of innovators, developers, and problem solvers committed to creating impactful solutions through technology. We combine creativity, technical skills, and collaboration to tackle challenging problems and turn ideas into reality.
summary:
AstroPulse is a comprehensive health monitoring software designed for astronauts on long-duration space missions, addressing key spaceflight hazards like radiation, microgravity, and isolation.

Built using Python Flask, SQLite, and an interactive HTML/JS frontend, the platform features:

Interactive Body Map: A color-coded anatomical dashboard letting astronauts instantly assess body systems at a glance.

Vital Telemetry & Tracking: Real-time logging and dynamic charts for heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar, core temperature, sleep hours, and mood.

Autonomous Guidance: Built-in protocol instructions that translate anomalies into actionable countermeasure steps, critical for deep-space communication delays.

Gamification: Streak tracking and mission achievement badges to ensure high compliance with daily health routines.

AstroPulse empowers astronauts to independently monitor, diagnose, and treat health conditions during missions to the Moon, Mars, or deep space.
